visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young male and female sit side-by-side against a plain grey pleated curtain. The male on the left wears a black hooded sweatshirt with a small white graphic and olive-green trousers. The female on the right wears a light grey hooded sweatshirt, transparent-framed glasses, and grey corduroy trousers. She holds a small yellow sign with blue text on a stick. Both are smiling brightly and clapping their hands with high energy. (2) The scene shifts to a medium close-up of the female speaking animatedly. She gestures with her right hand in an open-palm motion while the male, partially in frame, listens with a smile. Bright yellow and blue text boxes with Chinese characters appear at the bottom center. The lighting is flat and bright, typical of a studio setting. (3) The camera alternates between close-ups of the male and female. The male has multiple earrings and a neat hairstyle, speaking with expressive eyes. The female points towards the camera and moves her sign slightly. In several frames, additional variety-style captions with emojis and decorative borders appear near their heads. (4) Both characters are back in a medium shot, looking directly at the viewer. They use large hand gestures to emphasize their points. A large, semi-transparent pink and yellow text block appears at the end, covering the lower third of the screen with social media information and a call to action.
